title: Gravitec vacuum-chamber tests

tellings.quote: Gravitech has done it in a vacuum chamber. They used to contract for NAZA

plain: Gary McKinnon, a computer hacker who says he found signs of a secret NASA space programme, passes on something a man named Henrik told him. According to McKinnon, a company called Gravitec has tested its technology in a vacuum chamber, a sealed room with the air pumped out, and once did contract work for NASA, the US space agency. If true, it would mean some unusual propulsion idea had worked outside normal air.
